scope: A coarse milestone abstraction for one recorded attachment episode and its follow-up snapshot. Ever reached and final present are different facts. Sources span trace/snapshot reporting, not a common physical wire clock. Entry means admission to USB4-domain operation, including compatible mode where applicable; it does not mean a native Enter_USB packet was captured. Failure-stage rows partition the modeled unfinished milestone, not the root cause. Exit is a cross-cutting event. Logical combinations have no assigned probability.

variables.meaning: Domain-mode entry was achieved at least once in this episode
variables.observation_limit: Requires an understood entry/history witness. A cached NotAttemptedOrExited code is unknown; an inferred domain milestone is not a captured native Enter_USB request/Accept.

variables.meaning: A usable USB4-domain link existed at least once
variables.observation_limit: A qualified positive link-ready sample can witness this. A negative current sample cannot prove never-ready; that requires validated event/history coverage.

variables.meaning: An operational external router was established at least once
variables.observation_limit: Requires a fresh, correctly owned operational-router witness. A cached node, a capability bit or merely identifying a register is insufficient.

variables.meaning: The external router is present at the final recorded observation
variables.observation_limit: A recorded topology/inventory result is scoped to its snapshot. It does not establish whether a router existed earlier.

variables.meaning: Domain-mode exit occurred after an entry during this episode
variables.observation_limit: Requires understood ordered history. Exit may occur before usable link/router creation; later re-entry is allowed. No captured exit is unknown without complete coverage.

variables.meaning: Captured normal host UCSI exchanges completed successfully
variables.observation_limit: The captured commands/completions and CCI errors can establish this control-path fact. It has no implication to E, L or R.

implications.assumption: For this coarse model a valid domain link follows successful domain-mode admission. A contradictory record requires checking field meaning, timestamps and this assumption.
An operational external router requires a usable domain link; stale software objects are excluded from R's definition.
A genuinely present operational router at the final observation is also an ever-present witness.
X is specifically an exit after entry. It is not a generic disconnect, failed request or descriptor error.

E.reason: C11/C12: cached device status cannot separate skipped entry from exit; no fresh entry witness.

L.reason: C04/C19: no qualified usable-link history; no-router checks are not never-link evidence.

R.reason: C04: final absence and sampled No checks do not prove an operational router never existed transiently.

F.reason: ASUS-COMPARE /asus_external_routers =0 in the recorded normal failed comparison snapshot.

X.reason: C11/C12: NotAttemptedOrExited is not an ordered exit witness.

C.reason: Pinned ASUS-COMMANDS/ASUS-COMPLETIONS/ASUS-ERRORS establish10 commands,10 terminal completions and zero CCI error/busy/unsupported. A failed quality rule would leave C unknown.

E.reason: No direct wire-entry observation is imported. Any model implication from an operational router is labeled inferred.

L.reason: No standalone link-history field is imported; downstream operational-router evidence may imply a milestone within the abstract model.

R.reason: The direct imported topology fact is F; F implies R within the model.

F.reason: DELL-WORKING records a newly present router in the successful earlier control. This is not the later Dell deep-dump timeline.

X.reason: No complete entry/exit history is imported; successful final state alone does not exclude an earlier exit/re-entry.

C.reason: The pinned Dell control records matched command/completion counts with zero error completions. It is a host-control result.

E.reason: Suppressing the Windows role command supplies no direct entry witness.

L.reason: The policy-only trial did not record qualified physical-link history.

R.reason: The final inventory does not by itself establish absence throughout the whole trial.

F.reason: POLICY-PAIR /observation/RouterPresent is false after the one experimental attachment; stock and override are distinct cases.

X.reason: No qualified ordered entry/exit history in this trial.

C.reason: This runner does not substitute per-command summary counts for a new complete terminal-completion comparison in the override case.
